description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Rice Valid for a period of 04 months commencing from 26.03.2015
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy on rice products under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures, specifies levy rates, and rescinds a previous order. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
